🧠 DAILY SMC MARKET MAP — BTC + GOLD

Fresh market data | Daily → 4H → 1H → 15M
Closed candles used. No setup is an entry until lower-timeframe confirmation occurs.

🔥 STRONGEST CRYPTO SETUP — BTCUSDT BUY
Current: ~$86,224

HTF READ
• Daily structure is bullish. Price has reclaimed the $84K area and is pressing back toward the $86.8K–$87.0K buy-side liquidity zone.
• 4H structure remains bullish after the displacement from ~$84.3K into ~$86.8K.
• Recent sell-side liquidity was swept around $85.4K before price reclaimed higher.
• 1H/15M show recovery from the $85.4K–$85.8K demand area.

🎯 PRIMARY LONG
Wait for a retracement into $85,800–$86,050, then require bullish 15M displacement/reclaim before considering entry.

Targets:
→ $86,800
→ $87,220
→ $88,000+

Invalidation: sustained loss of ~$85,412.
Stronger structural invalidation below ~$85,162.

🚀 BREAKOUT ALTERNATIVE
Clean 1H acceptance above $86,999 opens the path toward $87,220 and then $88,000+.

🟡 GOLD — XAUUSD SELL ON RETRACEMENT
Current: ~$4,167

HTF READ
• Daily structure remains bearish following the sharp rejection from the ~$4,520 area.
• 4H structure is still bearish below the $4,216–$4,225 supply/liquidity area.
• Price has bounced from ~$4,126–$4,130, so chasing the current move lower is poor R:R.

🎯 PRIMARY SHORT
Wait for a retracement into $4,168–$4,185, then require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim before entry.

Targets:
→ $4,138
→ $4,112
→ $4,050

Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~$4,225.
Stronger structural invalidation above ~$4,250.

ETHUSDT and BNBUSDT remain structurally bullish, but their current locations offer less attractive risk/reward than the BTC setup.

⚠️ SMC VERDICT
BTCUSDT BUY is the cleanest crypto setup. XAUUSD offers a conditional short if price retraces into supply and confirms bearish displacement. Do not chase either move.
